hint.type: Counts a Pokémon with {type} as one of its types. Forms are their own picks with their own types, stats and abilities. Mega Charizard X is Fire and Dragon, Alolan Raichu is Electric and Psychic.
hint.types: Counts the Pokémon's own types, so a form can differ from its species: Charizard is dual-typed, and so is Mega Charizard X. Forms are their own picks with their own types, stats and abilities.
hint.hisui: Debuted in Pokémon Legends: Arceus: the Hisuian forms (Hisuian Growlithe) and the seven new species (Wyrdeer, Kleavor, Ursaluna, Basculegion, Sneasler, Overqwil, Enamorus).
hint.region: The generation a species debuted in (Gen 8 is Galar, Legends: Arceus newcomers like Kleavor included). A regional form counts for the region it debuted in (Alolan Raichu is Alola, Raichu is Kanto). Megas and Gigantamax forms count for their species' region.
hint.form: The species has a regional form from that region, so the species and each of its forms count (Raichu and Alolan Raichu both match 'Has an Alolan form').
hint.stage: Its place in its evolution line. A baby is optional: Pikachu counts as Basic and as a second stage (after Pichu), Raichu as a second or third stage. A form follows its species here.
hint.item: Takes part in an evolution that uses or holds an item, from either side: stones, apples, held items (Onix and Steelix with a Metal Coat). Using a move 20 times is not an item. A form follows its species here.
hint.stone: Takes part in an evolution with one of the ten evolution stones, from either side: Pikachu and Raichu, Eevee and Vaporeon. The held Oval Stone doesn't count. A form follows its species here.
hint.kind: Takes part in an evolution of this kind, from either side: the Pokémon that evolves and the one it becomes. A form follows its species here.
hint.level: Takes part in an evolution of this kind, from either side: the Pokémon that evolves and the one it becomes. Level means reaching a set level (Charmander at 16). A form follows its species here.
hint.branch: Its family splits somewhere: Eevee and every Eeveelution, the Oddish line (Vileplume or Bellossom), Scyther (Scizor or Kleavor). A form follows its species here.
hint.three: Its family reaches a third stage (Charmander's, or Pichu's with the baby). Eevee's family has nine species but only two stages. A form follows its species here.
hint.none: Doesn't evolve and doesn't evolve from anything (Tauros, Ditto). A form follows its species here.
hint.evo: Judged by the evolution line. A form follows its species here. Alolan Raichu is fully evolved, like Raichu; Mega Charizard X is a fully evolved Charmander line member.
hint.move: Needs the move in the species' learnset from the latest main game it is in (Scarlet & Violet for most), by level, TM, egg or tutor. Forms use their species' moves.
hint.hidden: Has an ability marked hidden. Abilities belong to the form picked: Mega Charizard X has only Tough Claws, so it has no hidden ability.
hint.ability: Has this ability in any slot. Abilities belong to the form picked: Mega Charizard X has Tough Claws, not Blaze.
hint.stat: Uses base stats of the form picked: a Mega Evolution's stats are its own, higher than its species'.
hint.mega: The species has a Mega Evolution, so the species and each of its forms count (Charizard and Mega Charizard X). Includes the Megas new in Legends: Z-A, like Dragonite and Greninja.
hint.gmax: The species has a Gigantamax form, so the species and each of its forms count (Pikachu and Gigantamax Pikachu).
hint.paradox: Hand-kept list of the official Paradox Pokémon (Great Tusk to Iron Crown). Forms follow their species.
hint.ultrabeast: Hand-kept list of the eleven Ultra Beasts (Nihilego to Blacephalon). Necrozma is not one. Forms follow their species.
hint.partner: Any Pokémon in the evolution line of a main-series starter from Kanto to Paldea. A form follows its species here.
hint.ou: Appears in the Gen 9 OU usage data (Smogon). A regional form counts only when it is the one used: Galarian Slowking is OU, Slowking is not. Other forms follow their species.
hint.status: Legendary, Mythical, fossil and baby status belong to the species. A form follows its species here.
